name: Space Ball 2.0
author: unity_8E8CF5B01AD164B149CD
description: Travel through the stars with Space Ball! Instructions: Use the arrow keys to move the player (the red ball) up, down, right and left. Use the space bar to jump. The goal of the game is to collect all of the blue orbs and then travel through the portal to another dimension. Watch out for black holes along the way!
